title: Univariate Categorical Feature Profiling
description: Characterization of nominal and ordinal feature frequency distributions, entropy, and dominance.
conditions: Initial exploration of categorical, boolean, or discrete status columns
Need to evaluate class balance, rare categories, and informational entropy
recommended_methods: Frequency table and percentage distribution computation
Shannon entropy calculation for categorical dispersion measurement
selection_rules: If top category accounts for > 95% of records, flag column as near-constant / low-variance
If cardinality equals record count, classify as candidate unique entity key
If categories with < 1% representation exceed 50% of total categories, plan long-tail grouping
limitations: Categorical profiling does not reveal intra-category semantic overlap or synonyms
Entropy metrics require adjustment when comparing features with disparate cardinality
